note: Open issues per repository, stacked by difficulty level. Each tab limits to issues labelled with a difficulty (or newly created) within its span; 'All time' is the whole open backlog and 'Unknown' = open issues not yet triaged. Wider spans are the closest view of a repo's accumulated triage debt.
methodology: Fetch every open issue across the organisation's repositories, with its labels.
Map each issue's labels to a difficulty level using the shared label vocabulary (domain/labels.py); an issue carrying no difficulty label becomes 'Unknown'.
Keep only issues labelled with a difficulty — or newly created — within the selected span, so the narrower tabs reflect what triage has touched recently; 'All time' keeps the whole open backlog.
Count the remaining open issues per repository, stacked by difficulty level.
population: Open issues in each repository, by difficulty label. 'Unknown' is an open issue with no difficulty label yet. Each issue is counted once.
